100%. Loading took 13 years.

The fresh start effect: goals are more likely to start right after a temporal landmark (a new week, month, year or a holiday), but a landmark only helps if you use it (Dai, Milkman & Riis, 2014, Management Science, doi:10.1287/mnsc.2014.1901). Archival data, not an experiment.

alt: A short film with no voice. The same night-city loading screen as before, with the year 2026 on top and the bar stuck at 99 percent. After a moment the bar fills to 100 percent in green, the text changes to LOADING COMPLETE and a yellow figure with white eyes and no hands gets happy eyes. A card says: LOADING COMPLETE, No excuses were installed, and a blinking PRESS ANY KEY follows.
comentario_fijado: What is your first move now that it's loaded?
